# PhysicsContactReport 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsContactReport:Void entity:Int32, report:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `report` | In | Int32 | required | 1 to report, 0 to stop. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Lets a body report what touches it. After each `PhysicsUpdate`, `GetPhysicsContactCount` and the `GetPhysicsContact...` commands list the contacts of the bodies that report. A pair is listed once when either body reports. Contacts with a sensor are listed too, with `GetPhysicsContactSensor` set, which is how a program learns that something is inside a region.

Bodies do not report by default, since collecting contacts costs time.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
